subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw ship `sourceActor` as the generic untrusted attribution contract for plugin tools and memory corpus supplements after the missed fallback is repaired?
rationale: The mechanical bug is clear, but the PR also promotes a new public plugin SDK and memory recall attribution surface that automation cannot approve as long-term product/API direction.

options.title: Approve generic contract after repair
options.body: Fix the empty-miss fallback, keep the fields optional and untrusted, and land the stacked SDK/memory attribution contract in order.

options.title: Narrow to channel-only attribution
options.body: Keep source actor on inbound channel context and defer memory supplement exposure until memory backend ownership is settled.

options.title: Pause for trust-tagging design
options.body: Hold this stack until broader memory trust tagging and persisted attribution are designed together.

recommendation.title: Approve generic contract after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the empty-miss fallback, keep the fields optional and untrusted, and land the stacked SDK/memory attribution contract in order.
